title: God of War Ragnarök
japaneseTitle: ゴッド・オブ・ウォー ラグナロク
shortDescription: The cataclysmic conclusion to Kratos and Atreus's Norse saga, traversing all Nine Realms as the prophesied twilight of the gods approaches.
historicalSignificance: Became the fastest-selling first-party launch in PlayStation history with 5.1 million copies sold in its debut week (and 15+ million overall), winning six awards at The Game Awards 2022.

editorialContent.overview: With the freezing winds of Fimbulwinter consuming Midgard, Kratos and teenage Atreus must choose between self-preservation and the fate of the realms as Odin and a vengeful Thor mobilize the Aesir for Ragnarök.
editorialContent.gameplay: Deepens combat with vertical grappling zip-strikes, elemental weapon infusing (Frost, Fire, and the new Draupnir Spear with unlimited kinetic detonator spikes), and dedicated playable chapters controlling Atreus with rapid bow combat.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Flawlessly maintains the continuous single-take camera across a 40-hour grand epic while rendering all Nine Realms with native 4K 60-120Hz high frame rate modes.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Praised for its mature, nuanced examination of generational trauma, fate, and redemption, featuring stellar performances from Christopher Judge and Richard Schiff.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS5 Ultra HD disc, PS4 dual-layer disc, and expanded with the free Valhalla roguelike epilogue.

awards: 6 Awards at The Game Awards 2022 (Best Narrative, Best Score, Best Performance, Best Audio, Innovation in Accessibility, Best Action/Adventure)

technicalSpecs.soundChip: 3D Tempest Audio with Bear McCreary orchestral score
